Subject: Proposal: quality monitoring baseline & onboarding next steps

Hi Marissa / Samantha,

Following our demo last week, I wanted to put a concise proposal for the quality monitoring setup we recommend for Acme's payments assistant. Goal: short time-to-value so your team can detect regressions early and run controlled canaries during model swaps.

High-level deliverables (week 1-3):
- Prompt set & production sample collection (we'll seed with a 150-case prompt set you share)
- Eval harness integration: run baseline metrics (BLEU/ROUGE irrelevant for chat; we'll use task-specific success signals + semantic-similarity thresholds)
- Canary policy: 5% traffic canary for 48 hours with automated rollback triggers on either (a) >3% absolute drop in success rate vs baseline OR (b) >2x increase in P95 latency
- Regression alerts: send to pager and Slack, create a mid-priority incident if thresholds breach twice within 1 hour
- Onboarding runbook + run-through call (30–45m)

I've attached a starter prompt set (qm-prompt-set-v1.csv) and a suggested eval harness config (eval-harness-config.yml). Please confirm who on the Acme side will provide labeled success/failure signals or acceptance criteria (example: transaction classification, routing accuracy).

Proposed timeline: start collection this week, baseline run by next Tue (2026-03-31), canary the following week.

If this looks good I'll transition the handoff formally to Marissa for CS onboarding and schedule the runbook walk-through.

Thanks,
Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-24T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: canary thresholds, eval cadence, alert routing (Acme)

Neha / Priyom — quick internal note before we lock the runbook. Summary of what we want in the canary and monitoring setup for Acme: 

1) Canary plan
- Traffic: 5% initial; step up to 20% over 24 hours if no alerts.
- Duration: minimum 48h at steady state before full rollout unless rollback triggers.
- Rollback triggers (automated):
  * Success-rate drop: absolute drop >=3 percentage points vs baseline over rolling 1h window
  * Latency spike: P95 latency > 2x baseline for >= 30min
  * Error rate: >0.5% API error rate sustained for 15min
- Manual rollback: any critical business owner flag or data-evidence manual review.

2) Eval harness integration
- Runs: scheduled nightly baseline runs for first 7 days, then every other day for 2 weeks, then weekly.
- Metrics: task success (binary), semantic similarity (embedding cosine with threshold 0.78), hallucination count (heuristic), latency P50/P95.
- Baseline compute: first 3 nightly runs average = canonical baseline.

3) Alerts & paging
- Sev2 (warning): 10% drop in success over 3h — notify Slack (#acme-monitoring) and email to oncall@acme (customer) + Neha.
- Sev1 (action/rollback): any automated rollback trigger — page Redwood oncall + DM Marissa.

4) Access & credentials
- Priyom to provision eval harness credentials and upload API keys (use customer-provided read-only keys for production samples).

Please comment inline if you see issues. I'll fold this into the runbook and share with Acme after the samples arrive.

— Marissa

Onboarding checklist (owner)

- Eval harness credentials + config: Priyom (deliverable: eval-harness-config.yml).
- Baseline runs: Priyom to kick off nightly runs starting tonight; we will compute canonical baseline after 3 runs.
- Canary deploy: Rishi will coordinate the 5% traffic canary on 2026-04-01 (tentative).
- Alerts & paging: Neha to configure Console alerts and Slack channel (#acme-monitoring). She will create the incident playbook for Sev1/Sev2.
- Runbook deliverable: Marissa to publish final canary-runbook-v1.pdf and share with Acme; includes rollback steps and communication templates.

Key acceptance criteria for canary
- No single metric breach that meets automated rollback conditions during a rolling 48h window.
- Customer sign-off after 48h steady-state.

Communication plan
- Sev2: Slack + email to oncall@acmepayments.com (no page).
- Sev1: Redwood oncall pages + Marissa notified via phone.

Next steps (timeline)
- 2026-03-29: Priyom to provision credentials and start baseline runs.
- 2026-03-31: Baseline summary delivered to Acme and internal team.
- 2026-04-01: Target canary start (Rishi to lead).

Attachments provided: qm-prompt-set-v1.csv, canary-runbook-v1.pdf, eval-harness-config.yml

If anything needs to change, please reply-all and I'll fold updates into the runbook. Otherwise I'll mark this handoff complete and follow up post-canary.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
